units.name: Mineral separation
units.function: Beach-wash mineral concentration, dry mill and separation of ilmenite, rutile, zircon and other mineral fractions.
units.inputs: beach-wash sand; water; dryer fuel; electricity
units.outputs: raw ilmenite and separately saleable mineral streams; rejects

units.name: Ilmenite beneficiation
units.function: Reduction, leaching, washing and calcination; sends chloride-rich spent liquor to ARP.
units.inputs: raw ilmenite; reductant; hydrochloric acid; wash water; heat; electricity
units.outputs: beneficiated ilmenite; spent chloride liquor; washes and off-gas

units.name: Acid regeneration
units.function: Oil-fired spray roasting and acid absorption; returns recovered HCl to IBP and separates iron oxide.
units.inputs: IBP spent liquor; oil; water/absorber liquor; power
units.outputs: recovered HCl loop; iron oxide; off-gas; rejects

units.name: Chlorination / TiCl4 purification
units.function: Chlorinate beneficiated ilmenite with chlorine and coke; condense and distil titanium tetrachloride.
units.inputs: beneficiated ilmenite; chlorine; petroleum coke; cooling; power
units.outputs: TiCl4 to U300, branch allocation to sponge/sales; impurity metal chlorides and purges

units.name: TiCl4 oxidation
units.function: Vapourise and oxidise titanium tetrachloride with oxygen to raw pigment slurry; chlorine is regenerated chemically.
units.outputs: raw TiO2; chlorine-containing streams; heat and off-gases

units.name: Pigment finishing
units.function: Surface treatment, classification, filtration/washing, drying, micronising and packaging.
units.inputs: raw TiO2 slurry; additives; water; steam; power
units.outputs: graded TiO2 pigment; fines; wash water; reject solids

units.name: Effluent treatment
units.function: Neutralisation and settling; outlet/recycle routing and solid storage require measured and permit records.

units.name: Titanium sponge — separate product boundary
units.function: TiCl4 metal-grade purification; Mg reduction, pyro-vacuum distillation, sponge finishing; MgCl2 co-product.

units.name: Steam, oxygen and utilities
units.function: Boiler steam, compressed air, oxygen, water treatment/DM; all cross-boundary energy and water must be allocated once.
units.outputs: steam; compressed air; treated water and utility rejects

streams.title: Iron oxide, fine and potentially acidic/chloride-bearing
streams.route: Iron-oxide separation/storage; KMML describes brick development/commercial introduction and FY2022–23 sponge-iron trial; do not infer percentage reused or 2026 outlet.
streams.necessary: wet/dry mass, Fe oxide grade, acid/chloride/trace constituents, age and pond vs fresh material, current destinations, actual kiln/processing energy, sales and residue controls

streams.title: Reclaimed hydrochloric acid
streams.route: Return to IBP leach; measured recovered HCl mass and concentration unknown.
streams.necessary: feed chloride species and volume, recovered acid volume/density/wt%, purge losses, fresh HCl purchases, oil/fuel/power for recovery

streams.title: Spent chloride liquor
streams.route: Not simultaneously an exported waste and an ARP recovery credit.
streams.necessary: tonnes, Fe(II)/Fe(III), free HCl, chloride, Ti and impurities, temperature, water

streams.title: Impurity metal chlorides, condensing/purge streams
streams.route: Recover TiCl4 by source-described stages; impurity-rich residue fate must be verified.
streams.necessary: tonnes, species, chlorides, titanium loss, storage/disposal and off-gas

streams.title: Chlorine from TiCl4 oxidation
streams.route: Potentially feed chlorination; net fresh chlorine displacement requires actual measured refeed, vent/scrub and storage data.
streams.necessary: kg Cl2 generated, consumed fresh/recycled, purges, scrubber bleed, inventories

streams.title: TiO2 fines in polishing/run-off water
streams.route: KMML reported 1.0–2.0 g/L in overflow and PAC settling trials; not proven commissioned recovery.
streams.necessary: flow m3/day, time-matched representative g/L, PAC dose, purity, dry solids recovery, product acceptance, sludge fate and new utility use

streams.title: Filter backwash water
streams.route: Report said approximately 300 m3/day generated and PAC trials suggested cooling make-up; not verified actual 2026 recycle.
streams.necessary: measured flow by date, conductivity/chloride, microbiology if relevant, PAC/sludge, actual reused m3, evaporative losses and make-up substitution

streams.title: Neutralisation sludge
streams.route: Settle/store under permit; not equivalent to ARP oxide. Reuse requires waste-code and leaching validation.
streams.necessary: as-generated dry/wet mass, pH/metals/chloride, disposal permit, leach testing, storage and treatment cost

streams.title: Useful rejected process heat / steam
streams.route: Screen source/sink temperature-duration matches and corrosion constraints before specifying technology.
streams.necessary: hourly temperature and flow, source/sink pinch, utility duty and shutdowns, fouling, capex and substitute fuel

streams.title: Magnesium chloride from Kroll branch
streams.route: Separate from pigment residuals; magnesium recovery mentioned historically as proposal, no current recovery credit.
streams.necessary: TiCl4 allocation, Mg charged, MgCl2 purity and moisture, current handling and verified Mg recovery

math_templates.acid: Recovered HCl (kg)=measured recovered solution (kg) × laboratory HCl mass fraction; fresh-acid displacement requires identical HCl basis and verified net import/substitution.
math_templates.oxide: Fe, Cl and water inputs = recovered products + transfers to other verified streams + emitted/aqueous residual + changes in inventory; segregate existing pond stock from new generation.
math_templates.fines: TiO2 entering overflow (kg)=measured Q (m3) × measured C (g/L) × 1 kg/(m3·g/L). Net saleable product=that quantity × actual captured fraction × accepted grade fraction; never substitute 300 m3/day backwash for unmeasured U400 overflow.
math_templates.water: Net freshwater displaced (m3)=verified accepted reuse to utility − any new freshwater consumed in treatment/recirculation; not the reported 300 m3/day without actual reuse.
math_templates.heat: Recovered useful heat (MWh_th)=integral over simultaneous feasible source and sink duties after ΔTmin, exchanger effectiveness, parasitic energy, corrosion/fouling and availability checks.
math_templates.value: Net incremental value = verified avoided purchases + accepted-product revenue + avoided compliant disposal costs − new reagent, energy, transport, quality, residue, maintenance, labour and annualised capex; do not double count internal transfers.
math_templates.emissions: Avoided emissions require the measured marginal displaced system, not imported average electricity × synthetic recovery.
